trap.label: transitivo
trap.wrong: The fingerprint match corroborates with the witness account.
trap.right: The fingerprint match corroborates the witness account.
trap.why: Em português “corroborar com” é comum. Em inglês, corroborate é transitivo direto.

fix.wrong: The test supports to the conclusion.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com corroborate: “The DNA confirms the account independently.”
Reescreva com rule out: “The lab eliminated that possibility.”
rewrite.answer: The lab ruled out that possibility.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com undermine: “The error weakens the result.”
